_comment: Per-item icon framing. yaw/pitch/roll are degrees applied to the model before the fixed 3/4 camera; zoom is the fraction of the frame the model fills (0.9 default); exposure multiplies ACES exposure (1.15 default). Tripo output facing is arbitrary — run the bake page with ?sheet (optionally &only=id,id) to render a yaw strip per item and pick from it. Items not listed here bake at the defaults, which is fine for roughly radial shapes (helmets, orbs, medallions); elongated items (bows, axes, staves) almost always need a yaw or they render edge-on.
